description:
FILED AND FIXED s470bi (Opus, 2026-09-05) while explaining an emission A/B.
PRE-EXISTING on main since #1035 step 3 (s469bg).  A HARD breakage: two files
of perl's own t/ and two CPAN board modules died at LOAD.

`Pl::CLForm::to_string` keeps a p-let DECLARATION ENTRY's name and its keyword
class on the head line (`(NAME CLASS INIT ...FACTS)`, ir-spec 2b.2a) and
prints the FACTS tail with `join`.  The branch is shape-keyed -- "a non-ref
atom, then a non-ref keyword atom" -- and the OTHER headless list this printer
sees is `p-sub`'s FACTS PLIST (ir-spec 5.1), whose `(:returns :str ...)` fits
that shape exactly.

Claimed as an entry, the plist's tail went through `join`, and `:captures`'s
value is an ARRAY REF (`['list', CELLS...]`).  Perl stringified it:

    (p-sub |pl-FETCH| (&rest %_args)
      (:returns :str :wantarray-insensitive t :writes-args nil
       :captures ARRAY(0x5e44d39feb40))

Three consequences, all silent at transpile time:
  (1) the emission is NON-DETERMINISTIC -- a fresh heap address per run.  Two
      transpiles of one file differ; main-vs-main reads DIFF.  That is how it
      was found: t/opbasic/concat.t and t/op/try.t were DIFF in an A/B whose
      change (a `goto` classifier) cannot reach them.
  (2) `ARRAY(0x...)` reads as TWO CL forms, so the plist has ODD length.
  (3) `%p-check-facts` therefore kills the file at LOAD:
      "p-sub: facts of pl-f are not keyword pairs".

REACHABLE when a sub has a proven `:returns` family AND a capture manifest AND
a plist too long to print flat (ONE_LINE_MAX 95).  MINIMAL REPRO
(scratch/s470bi/p1118/a.pl):

    my $first_captured_cell_name = "abc";
    my $second_captured_cell_name = "def";
    sub f { my $t = $first_captured_cell_name . $second_captured_cell_name;
            return "$t!" }
    print f(), "\n";

  perl 5.40.3: abcdef!     PCL before: dies at load.

MEASURED CASUALTIES on main: t/op/try.t, t/opbasic/concat.t,
cpan-tests YAML::Tiny, cpan-tests Test::Tester::Capture -- a whole file each.

=== DONE (s470bi) ===
FIX: one added conjunct -- a declaration entry's FIRST element is a NAME,
never a keyword (`$args[0] !~ /^:/`).  And since the facts plist is now a
shape the printer knows, it gets a plist's layout: a break between PAIRS,
never between a key and its value (`_is_plist`), which is the same argument
the entry branch's own FACTS-tail comment makes.

BARS: emission A/B over 1048 files (lib shims + perl 5.40.3's t/ + the CPAN
board) = SAME 1018 / DIFF 30 / RCDIFF 0, every DIFF classified
(scratch/s470bi/classify.pl): 14 carry a `goto` (s470bi's #1045), 4 are this
corruption fixed, 12 are the pair layout and are byte-identical once
whitespace is normalised.  corpus-diff 4 of 111 (args.t/sort.t/state.t =
#1045; undef.t = this layout), silent drops 5 unchanged.  The three checked-in
artifacts are unaffected (no long facts plist in them).

GUARDS: `Pl/t/decl-facts-01.t` +4 rows -- no arrayref in the output, the pair
layout with the cells named, two transpiles byte-identical after the tempfile
path is normalised, and the file LOADS.  All four inverse-verified against
main (all four fail there).


=== ADDENDUM (s470bi, at the merge review) ===
DUPLICATE CLOSED: **#1125** ("Emission is NONDETERMINISTIC: a Perl arrayref
stringification leaks into the :captures slot") is this bug, found
independently the same day by the A5 agent from the other end -- it met the
symptom as "the byte-compare says DIFF for no reason" while this task met it
as "why does main differ from itself in an emission A/B".  #1125 is closed
pointing here, with the correction that it understated the severity: the
odd-length plist does not merely defeat a byte-compare, it kills the file at
LOAD.

THE SWEEP COST ON MAIN, measured by Fable at the merge review and worth
recording because nothing else would have attributed it: on main `e73038f`
this bug cost **perl-tests/eval.t 36 passing rows -- 128 -> 92 -- and s470bi's
tree restores it to 128 passing / 32 failing, last test 163**.  It hid well:
`PCL_OPT=-raw-op-family` and `PCL_OPT=-raw-return-family` each MASKED it,
because the form carrying the corrupted `:captures` only reached the emitted
file under the default emissions.  That is the shape to remember -- an
emission bug that a PCL_OPT bisect makes disappear is not "not an emission
bug", it is one whose form only some emissions produce.
subject: FIXED s470bi: p-sub's FACTS PLIST matched the p-let DECLARATION-ENTRY layout shape, so :captures' arrayref was stringified into the CL as ARRAY(0x...) -- non-deterministic emission and death at LOAD (t/op/try.t, t/opbasic/concat.t, 2 CPAN modules)
